description: DEP-06 Phase 4 step 2: each armer's arm for re-arm round `round` in the window (opens, closes]: the latest by sequence of its first 4 arms (the bound spans every round and height) that is of `round` and whose signed block_height h satisfies opens < h <= closes. Arms outside the window or of other rounds count against the bound but never displace an in-window arm. `expect` lists the chosen arm per armer (armers absent from it have none). Shared by cl-deposits (inspect/lottery-test.lisp, pick-round-arms) and deposits-rust (deposits-node armers.rs, pick_round_arms).

cases.name: an in-window arm then a same-round arm between windows: the armer stays in the cut
the later arm in a later recurring window: the earlier window keeps the in-window arm
the same arms, judged in the later window: its own in-window arm
two arms inside the window: the latest counts
the four-arm bound spans rounds and windows: a fifth arm inside the window does not count
the bound with every counted arm outside the window: no arm, though a fifth is inside
an arm on the open boundary is outside, on the close boundary inside
another round's arm in the window is not this round's
